items.exampleEn: Our shop needs more workers to keep up with all the orders.
items.exampleZh: 我們店需要更多人手，才跟得上所有的訂單。

items.exampleEn: Everyone in our office looks forward to Friday afternoon.
items.exampleZh: 我們辦公室裡每個人都很期待星期五下午。

items.exampleEn: The police are looking into what happened at the market last night.
items.exampleZh: 警方正在調查昨晚市場發生了什麼事。

items.exampleEn: Many young players look up to their coach.
items.exampleZh: 許多年輕球員都很尊敬他們的教練。

items.exampleEn: He looks down on anyone who can't speak English well.
items.exampleZh: 他看不起英文說得不好的人。

items.exampleEn: She made up a story about a talking cat.
items.exampleZh: 她編了一個關於會說話的貓的故事。

items.exampleEn: My teacher found a mistake in my essay and pointed it out.
items.exampleZh: 老師發現我作文裡有個錯誤，並把它指了出來。

items.sentenceEn: My grandma is looking forward to her birthday party.
items.sentenceZh: 我奶奶很期待她的生日派對。

items.audioEn: Tom said his bus was late, but I think he made that up.
items.audioZh: Tom 說他的公車誤點了，但我覺得那是他編的。
items.questionZh: 說話的人認為 Tom 說的話怎麼樣？
options: It was about his new bike

items.sentenceEn: It's hard to keep up with the news these days.
Can you point out where we are on this map?
items.sentenceZh: 你可以指出我們在這張地圖上的哪裡嗎？

items.stemEn: I really ____ my grandfather. He worked hard all his life and helped many people.
items.stemZh: 我很尊敬我爺爺。他一輩子努力工作，幫助了很多人。

items.stemEn: The manager promised to ____ our complaint and call us back.
items.stemZh: 經理答應會調查我們的投訴，再回電給我們。

items.passageEn: Ben and his best friend Sam had a big fight last week. Sam said Ben looked down on him because Ben always got better grades. Ben felt terrible. His older sister, whom he really looks up to, pointed out that Sam was probably just tired. She said Sam was constantly working hard to keep up with the class. The next day, Ben said sorry, and the two boys made up. Now they are looking forward to the school trip together.
items.passageZh: Ben 和他最好的朋友 Sam 上星期大吵一架。Sam 說 Ben 看不起他，因為 Ben 成績總是比較好。Ben 很難過。他非常尊敬的姊姊指出，Sam 可能只是累了。她說 Sam 一直很努力地跟上全班的進度。隔天，Ben 道了歉，兩個男孩就和好了。現在他們一起期待著校外教學。

questions.questionZh: Sam 為什麼跟 Ben 吵架？
options: Ben 拿走了他的新書包
他覺得 Ben 看不起他

questions.questionZh: 誰跟 Ben 說 Sam 可能只是累了？

items.promptZh: 我很期待明天跟你見面。
referenceEn: I'm really looking forward to meeting you tomorrow.
I am looking forward to seeing you tomorrow.
I really look forward to meeting you tomorrow.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 looking forward to meeting、seeing 等（to 後接動名詞）
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 can't wait to meet you 等）也算對
時態可用現在進行式或現在式（例如 am looking forward to、look forward to 等）
「很」可寫，例如 really 等，不寫也可以

items.promptZh: 老師講得太快，我跟不上。
referenceEn: The teacher speaks too fast, and I can't keep up with her.
The teacher talks so fast that I can't keep up with him.
The teacher spoke too fast, so I couldn't keep up with her.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 keep up with her、keep up 等
不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 can't follow her 等）也算對
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 speaks、spoke；can't、couldn't 等）
「老師」的代名詞可用，例如 her、him 等
